records.issue_text: Removing the allowed-host check makes existing embedded topics expandable whenever `embed_truncate` is enabled, even after all embedding hosts are removed.
records.rationale: The diff changes Topic#expandable_first_post? from requiring `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to only `embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`. With hosts now stored in the embeddable_hosts table (and no presence check against that table), existing topics with topic_embeds stay expandable even after an admin deletes every allowed host, which the old check explicitly prevented. This is a verifiable behavior regression (or at minimum a substantive security/behavioral consequence) introduced by the diff.
